notes.title: Update 1.6.1 (New songs, gameplay improvements, and bug fixes)
notes.notes:
It's been a long wait, but we've finally released Steno Arcade version 1.6.1, a culmination of internal builds 1.2.1-1.6.1, which includes new Steno Hero songs, general gameplay improvements, and bug fixes. Details below:

1.6.1:
[list]
[*]Now, whenever the “more info” button is pressed to show song lyrics, buttons that have mouse focus takes precedence over buttons that have key focus
[*]Added support for the scroll wheel for the song list in Steno Hero
[*]Added more space before the “Contributors” header in the credits popup
[*]Slightly edited which beeps play when the song start in Steno Hero
[*]Fixed a bug where holding the song button then pressing the lyrics button causes the menu music to play over the song in-game
[*]Fixed a bug where holding the song button causes the song to play after lyrics are displayed
[*]Altered the color "grading" on lines in Steno Hero to affect the last word, before space is pressed
[/list]

1.6.0:
[list]
[*]Added readme and license
[/list]

1.5.0:
[list]
[*]Added new audience members
[*]Added beeps to the timer at start of Steno Hero
[/list]

1.4.0:
[list]
[*]Added song preview that plays the song when the user views the lyrics
[*]Added new songs:
[list]
[*]“Antarctic Moon” by Dan O’Connor
[*]“Code Monkey” by Jonathan Coulton
[*]“Cherubs” by Josh Woodward
[*]“Learn to Fly” by Josh Woodward
[*]“Let It In” by Josh Woodward
[*]“My Favorite Regret” by Josh Woodward
[*]“On Brevity” by Josh Woodward
[*]“Steno Hero” by Josh Woodward
[*]“The Most” by Ancient Free Gardeners
[/list]
[/list]

1.3.0:
[list]
[*]Added first pass of screen reader support. On Windows only, supports any reader using Microsoft’s IAccessible framework (Microsoft Narrator, NVDA..)
[/list]

1.2.1:
[list]
[*]Added contributor names to credits
[/list]

What's next?
We're close to completing Steno Hero. We'll be adding one more song, evaluating the song difficulty rankings based on player feedback, and will do our best to address any reported bugs, but otherwise Steno Hero is complete and we'll be starting work on one of the other games in the Steno Arcade collection.

notes.title: Community-developed song editor for Steno Hero!
notes.notes:
A member of the Steno Arcade community has developed a song editor that makes it easy to create .LRC files for Steno Hero from your own songs. Learn more here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/449000/discussions/0/359543542236219052/

notes.title: New song added to Steno Hero + gameplay improvements!
notes.notes:
We've released Steno Arcade version 1.1.8, which includes a new Steno Hero song and some general gameplay improvements. Details below:
[list]
[*]We've added the song "The Standing Ones" by Hungry Lucy under "Very Easy" difficulty.
[*]Cut down the instrumental intro in "Sunday Smiled" by Hungry Lucy to allow the player to more quickly begin play.
[*]Cut down the instrumental intro in "I Think I Started a Trend" by Brad Sucks to allow the player to more quickly begin play.
[/list]
What's next?
We're currently working on another update that will introduce two more "Very Easy" songs from artists not currently in the game. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Two new songs added to Steno Hero!
notes.notes:
We've released Steno Arcade version 1.1.7, which includes two new Steno Hero songs and a minor bug fix. Details below:

We've added two new, "Very Easy" songs to Steno Hero:
[list]
[*]"Sunday Smiled" by Hungry Lucy
[*]"I Think I Started a Trend" by Brad Sucks
[/list]
We know that many have been complaining about the difficulty of the songs in Steno Hero, so we've added these two new tracks in the hopes of making the game more accessible. Let us know what you think.

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash that was caused when the user pressed specific keys in-game.
[/list]
We're also aware of a bug that's causing Steno Arcade to crash on start-up. It's affecting a very small number of players which is making it difficult to troubleshoot, but we hope to have the matter resolved in our next update.
